topics.title: be 动词的用法
topics.summary: be 动词包括 am, is, are，根据主语不同变化。
rules: I 用 am
You / We / They / 复数名词用 are
He / She / It / 单数名词用 is
否定句在 be 动词后加 not

quiz.question: I ___ a boy.
quiz.explanation: 主语是 I，所以用 am。

quiz.question: She ___ my sister.
quiz.explanation: 主语是 She，单数第三人称，用 is。

quiz.question: They ___ my friends.
quiz.explanation: 主语是 They (复数)，用 are。

quiz.question: We ___ happy today.
quiz.explanation: 主语是 We (复数)，用 are。

quiz.question: It ___ a cat.
quiz.explanation: 主语是 It，第三人称单数，用 is。

topics.title: There be 句型
topics.summary: There be 句型表示 「某地有某物」，be 动词的形式与后面紧跟的名词一致。
rules: There is + 单数可数名词 / 不可数名词
There are + 复数名词
就近原则：be 动词跟距离最近的那个名词保持一致
否定句直接在 be 后加 not

examples.en: There is a book on the desk.
There are many students in the classroom.
There is some milk in the cup.

quiz.question: There ___ a pen on the table.
quiz.explanation: a pen 是单数，用 is。

quiz.question: There ___ five apples in the box.
quiz.explanation: five apples 是复数，用 are。

quiz.question: There ___ some water in the bottle.
quiz.explanation: water 是不可数名词，用 is。

quiz.question: There ___ two dogs and a cat.
quiz.explanation: 就近原则：be 跟离它最近的名词一致——最近的是 two dogs（复数），用 are。

quiz.question: There ___ many books in my bag.
quiz.explanation: many books 是复数，用 are。

topics.title: 一般现在时
topics.summary: 一般现在时表示经常性的动作或状态，主语是第三人称单数时动词要加 -s 或 -es。
rules: I/You/We/They + 动词原形
He/She/It + 动词第三人称单数 (动词+s/es)
否定句用 don't / doesn't + 动词原形
疑问句用 Do / Does + 主语 + 动词原形

examples.en: I go to school every day.

quiz.question: She ___ to school every day.
quiz.explanation: she 是第三人称单数，go 要变 goes。

quiz.question: I ___ apples.
quiz.explanation: 主语 I，动词用原形。

quiz.question: He ___ TV in the evening.
quiz.explanation: He 是第三人称单数，watch 以 ch 结尾要加 es。

quiz.question: They ___ play football on Sunday.
quiz.explanation: they 用 don't。

quiz.question: ___ she like English?
quiz.explanation: she 用 Does 提问。

topics.title: 一般过去时
topics.summary: 一般过去时表示过去发生的动作或状态，动词要用过去式。
rules: be 动词过去式：was / were
实义动词的过去式：规则动词 +ed，不规则动词需单独记忆
否定句：didn't + 动词原形
时间标志词：yesterday, last week, ago, in 1999 等

examples.en: I went to the park yesterday.

quiz.question: I ___ to the zoo last Sunday.
quiz.explanation: last Sunday 表示过去，go 的过去式是 went。

quiz.question: She ___ at home yesterday.
quiz.explanation: she 单数 + 过去时间，用 was。

quiz.question: They ___ happy last weekend.
quiz.explanation: they 是复数 + 过去时，用 were。

quiz.question: He ___ play basketball yesterday.
quiz.explanation: 过去时否定用 didn't。

quiz.question: We ___ dinner two hours ago.
quiz.explanation: two hours ago 表示过去，have 的过去式是 had。

topics.title: 现在进行时
topics.summary: 现在进行时表示此刻或现阶段正在进行的动作，由 be + 动词-ing 构成。
rules: 结构：am/is/are + V-ing
时间标志：now, at this moment, Look!, Listen!
动词加 -ing 规则：一般直接加 ing；以不发音 e 结尾去 e 加 ing；重读闭音节双写末字母加 ing

examples.en: I am reading a book now.

quiz.question: Look! She ___ a book.
quiz.explanation: Look! 提示现在进行时；she 用 is + V-ing。

quiz.question: I ___ TV now.
quiz.explanation: now + I，用 am + V-ing。

quiz.question: They ___ in the park.
quiz.explanation: they + 进行时用 are + V-ing。

quiz.question: He is ___ a letter.
quiz.explanation: write 去 e 加 ing 变 writing。

quiz.question: We ___ swimming now.
quiz.explanation: we + V-ing 用 are。

topics.title: 情态动词 can
topics.summary: can 表示能力或可能性，意思是 「能够、可以」。
rules: can + 动词原形
否定：cannot / can't
疑问句：Can + 主语 + 动词原形?
can 没有人称和数的变化

quiz.question: I can ___ a bike.
quiz.explanation: can 后接动词原形。

quiz.question: She ___ play the piano.
quiz.explanation: can 没有人称变化。

quiz.question: ___ you swim?
quiz.explanation: 问能力用 Can。

quiz.question: He ___ speak English.
quiz.explanation: can 的否定形式是 can't。

quiz.question: Birds can ___.
quiz.explanation: can 后接动词原形。

topics.title: 人称代词
topics.summary: 人称代词分主格和宾格，要根据在句中作主语还是宾语来选用。
rules: 主格做主语：I, you, he, she, it, we, they
宾格做宾语：me, you, him, her, it, us, them
形容词性物主代词：my, your, his, her, its, our, their
名词性物主代词：mine, yours, his, hers, its, ours, theirs

quiz.question: Please give ___ the book.
quiz.explanation: give 后跟宾格 me。

quiz.question: This is ___ pen.
quiz.explanation: pen 前用形容词性物主代词 my。

quiz.question: The hat is ___.
quiz.explanation: 句末单独用名词性物主代词 mine。

quiz.question: She likes ___.
quiz.explanation: 动词后用宾格 him。

quiz.question: ___ are good students.
quiz.explanation: 句首做主语用 We。

topics.title: 可数名词与不可数名词
topics.summary: 英语名词分可数和不可数。可数名词有单复数，不可数名词只有单数形式。
rules: 可数名词复数一般加 -s；以 s/x/sh/ch 结尾加 -es；以辅音字母+y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 -es
不可数名词如 water, milk, bread 等不能直接加 a/an，也没有复数
不可数名词用 some, much, a lot of 修饰；用 a glass of, a piece of 等量词表示数量

examples.en: I'd like a piece of bread.

quiz.question: I have three ___.
quiz.explanation: three 后接复数名词 books。

quiz.question: There is ___ milk in the bottle.
quiz.explanation: milk 不可数，用 some。

quiz.question: Look at the ___.
quiz.explanation: box 以 x 结尾，复数加 es。

quiz.question: How ___ water do you want?
quiz.explanation: water 不可数，用 much。

quiz.question: I'd like a ___ of bread.
quiz.explanation: 面包用 piece 作量词。

topics.title: 形容词比较级
topics.summary: 形容词比较级用于两个事物的比较，表示 「更...」。
rules: 比较级 + than
单音节词加 -er：tall → taller
以 e 结尾的加 -r：nice → nicer
辅音+y 变 y 为 i 加 -er：happy → happier
重读闭音节双写末字母加 -er：big → bigger
多音节词前加 more：beautiful → more beautiful
不规则：good → better, bad → worse, many/much → more

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.zh: 这本书比那本书更有趣。

quiz.question: He is ___ than me.
quiz.explanation: than 前用比较级 taller。

quiz.question: This bag is ___ than that one.
quiz.explanation: heavy 变 y 为 i 加 er。

quiz.question: Math is ___ than English for me.
quiz.explanation: difficult 是多音节词，用 more difficult。

quiz.question: She sings ___ than her sister.
quiz.explanation: well 的比较级是 better。

quiz.question: The red box is ___ than the blue one.
quiz.explanation: big 重读闭音节双写 g 加 er。

topics.title: 一般疑问句
topics.summary: 一般疑问句以 be 动词、助动词或情态动词开头，可以用 yes 或 no 回答。
rules: be 动词开头：Is/Am/Are + 主语 + ...?
实义动词用助动词 do/does/did 开头
情态动词 can/will 开头时直接前置
肯定回答 Yes, 主语 + be/do/can.
否定回答 No, 主语 + be/do/can + not.

examples.en: Are you a student? Yes, I am.
Does she like apples? No, she doesn't.
examples.zh: 她喜欢苹果吗？不，她不喜欢。

examples.en: Can you swim? Yes, I can.

quiz.question: ___ you happy? — Yes, I am.
quiz.explanation: you 用 are。

quiz.question: ___ she like reading?
quiz.explanation: she 实义动词 like，用 Does。

quiz.question: ___ they go to school by bus?
quiz.explanation: they 实义动词 go，用 Do。

quiz.question: ___ you swim?
quiz.explanation: 问能力用 Can。

quiz.question: Is he a doctor? — ___, he is.
quiz.explanation: 肯定回答用 Yes。
